rubric.S0: No actual personal fact: a generic task, empty form, fictional scene, or absent record. Categories empty for this disclosure task.
rubric.S1: Mild personal preference or routine, without sensitive domains or identifiers. Categories empty; action ALLOW.
rubric.S2: Actual personal finances or precise whereabouts; nonmedical personal circumstances of the speaker's minor child are S2 plus CHILD and THIRD_PARTY.
rubric.S3: Actual health, political belief, religious affiliation, criminal history, sexual information or personal identity identifiers.
rubric.category_closure: All explicitly asserted domains; subject relationship alone does not imply IDENTITY. These authored child predicates concern another minor and therefore include THIRD_PARTY. These authored THIRD_PARTY predicates assert health and therefore include HEALTH. This is scenario closure, not an implication between category enums. Explicit political donations/funding also count FINANCIAL. Sexual therapy also counts HEALTH if asserted; revised sexual interests case asserts no therapy.
rubric.visibility: P0 unrestricted public, P1 semi-public community, P2 authenticated access, P3 closed private group, P4 unshared self-only, PU no audience evidence. Visibility never erases sensitivity.
rubric.ambiguous: Uncertain actual/fictional status, unclear minor age, negated or hypothetical sensitive assertion, or conflicting audience evidence excluded before rendering. All included predicates explicitly assert actual facts; controls explicitly remove actuality.
rubric.ambiguity_revision: Sexual interests and unlabeled orientation explicitly assert no therapy/counselling. Minor family-contact arrangements are nonmedical; bed-wetting/delayed-speech rows explicitly retain HEALTH. Religious monastic vows explicitly assert adherence.

ambiguous_exclusions.reason: A possible diagnosis without an asserted actual record cannot receive a forced health target.
School attendance alone does not establish minor status.
Public link combined with a self-only audience claim gives conflicting visibility evidence.

R3 preserves all R2 allocations/labels while removing ambiguous fine and dental-service facts; all earlier release bytes retained and unscored.
